blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.campaign` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method retrieves a campaign by its ID. It sends a request to the
[Get Campaign](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#campaigns\_getcampaignsid) API route.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the campaign.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

the budget is applied globally. If the type is `use_by_attribute`, this field indicates the 
attribute the budget is tracked by. For example, `customer_id` means the budget is tracked per customer.

blocks.html:
This method manages the promotions of a campaign to either add or remove the association between them.
It sends a request to the [Manage Promotions](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#campaigns\_postcampaignsidpromotions)
API route.

types.name: payload
types.description: The promotions to add or remove associations to them.

children.name: add
children.description: The IDs of the items to create an association to.

children.name: remove
children.description: The IDs of the items to remove the association from.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request
